{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
  SELECT mb.component_id AS comp_id, mb.qty AS qty
  FROM model_bom mb
  JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = mb.model_id
  WHERE m.model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
    AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cb.child_component_id, bom.qty * cb.qty
  FROM bom
  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.comp_id
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = c.component_id
  WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(bom.qty) AS total_units
FROM bom
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.comp_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'"}

  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
  JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
    AND l.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-CA-19')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS line_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
  JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = s.sku_id
  JOIN sales_sku si ON si.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
  JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = si.sku_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'
    AND l.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-CA-19')
    AND s.is_bundle = true
),
-- recursive BOM expansion from models down to parts, tracking qty multiplier and order date
bom AS (
  SELECT lm.order_id, lm.order_date, lm.line_qty, lm.model_qty, mb.component_id, lm.model_qty * mb.qty AS mult
  FROM line_model lm
  JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = lm.model_id
    AND mb.valid_from <= lm.order_date AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR lm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.order_id, b.order_date, b.line_qty, b.model_qty, cb.child_component_id, b.mult * cb.qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = b.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = c.component_id
    AND cb.valid_from <= b.order_date AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR b.order_date <= b.order_date)
)
SELECT SUM(b.line_qty * b.mult) AS units
FROM bom b

 cur AS (SELECT component_id, qty FROM model_bom WHERE model_id=(SELECT model_id FROM m) AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to))
SELECT c.component_code
FROM hist h
JOIN component c ON c.component_id=h.component_id
LEFT JOIN cur cu ON cu.component_id=h.component_id
WHERE cu.component_id IS NULL OR cu.qty <> h.qty"}

{"action":"run_sql","sql":"WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
  SELECT mb.component_id AS comp_id, mb.qty AS qty
  FROM model_bom mb
  JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = mb.model_id
  WHERE m.model_code = 'NO3-160BLK32-0226'
    AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2023-11-06'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2023-11-06' <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cb.child_component_id, bom.qty * cb.qty
  FROM bom
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bom.comp_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2023-11-06'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2023-11-06' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(b.qty * c.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom b
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = b.comp_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE skus AS (SELECT bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id, bi.qty::BIGINT AS q FROM bundle_item bi JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id WHERE s.sku_code = 'BDL-US-0239'), models AS (SELECT sm.model_id, SUM(sk.q * sm.qty) AS q FROM skus sk JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = sk.sku_id GROUP BY sm.model_id), tree AS (SELECT mb.component_id AS cid, m.q * mb.qty AS q FROM models m JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = m.model_id WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to) UNION ALL SELECT cb.child_component_id, t.q * cb.qty FROM tree t JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = t.cid WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.q), 0) AS units FROM tree t JOIN component c ON c.component_id = t.cid WHERE c.component_code = 'CAB-573-GRY-01774'"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE reach(model_id, component_id) AS (SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id FROM model_bom mb WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to) UNION SELECT r.model_id, cb.child_component_id FROM reach r JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = r.component_id WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)) SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code FROM reach r JOIN component c ON c.component_id = r.component_id JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = r.model_id WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-430-OAK-00477' ORDER BY cm.model_code"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE tgt AS (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'TAB-628-BLK-00280'), contains(cid) AS (SELECT component_id FROM tgt UNION SELECT cb.parent_component_id FROM component_bom cb JOIN contains c ON cb.child_component_id = c.cid WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)) SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code FROM model_bom mb JOIN contains c ON mb.component_id = c.cid JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to) ORDER BY cm.model_code"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE target AS (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'CAB-962-BLK-02120'), anc(component_id) AS (SELECT component_id FROM target UNION SELECT cb.parent_component_id FROM component_bom cb JOIN anc a ON cb.child_component_id = a.component_id WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)), models AS (SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id FROM model_bom mb JOIN anc a ON mb.component_id = a.component_id WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.sku_id) AS n FROM sales_sku s JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id JOIN models m ON sm.model_id = m.model_id WHERE NOT s.is_bundle"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE comp_tree(root_id, comp_id) AS (SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id FROM model_bom mb WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to) UNION ALL SELECT ct.root_id, cb.child_component_id FROM comp_tree ct JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = ct.comp_id WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)), models_with AS (SELECT DISTINCT ct.root_id AS model_id FROM comp_tree ct JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ct.comp_id WHERE c.component_code = 'GEA-681-BLK-02200') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.sku_id) AS sku_count FROM sales_sku s JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN models_with mw ON mw.model_id = sm.model_id WHERE s.is_bundle = false"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH lines AS (SELECT ol.qty, l.sku_id FROM order_line ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND s.country = 'US' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'), expanded AS (SELECT ln.qty * COALESCE(bi.qty, 1) AS qty, COALESCE(bi.item_sku_id, ln.sku_id) AS sku_id FROM lines ln JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = ln.sku_id LEFT JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.is_bundle AND bi.bundle_sku_id = ln.sku_id) SELECT cm.model_code, SUM(e.qty * sm.qty) AS units FROM expanded e JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = e.sku_id JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id GROUP BY cm.model_code ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 6"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH lines AS (SELECT l.sku_id, ol.qty FROM order_line ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND s.country = 'US' AND EXTRACT(year FROM o.order_date) = 2024), sku_units AS (SELECT x.sku_id, SUM(x.qty) AS qty FROM (SELECT ln.sku_id, ln.qty FROM lines ln JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = ln.sku_id WHERE NOT ss.is_bundle UNION ALL SELECT bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id, ln.qty * bi.qty AS qty FROM lines ln JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = ln.sku_id JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ln.sku_id WHERE ss.is_bundle) x GROUP BY x.sku_id) SELECT cm.model_code, SUM(su.qty * sm.qty) AS units FROM sku_units su JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = su.sku_id JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id GROUP BY cm.model_code ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 6"}
